identity.fantasy: A battlefield engineer who converts gunfire into Scrap, then routes that fuel through explosives, a combat suit, a mechanical beast, and upgraded turrets.
identity.one_line: The tree builds a Mechsuit and Scrapmaw, upgrades lasers, guns, jets, regeneration, and turrets, then overclocks the machine. Although the old game label reportedly calls it expert, current players say its effective damage loop can be extremely simple. The complexity sits more in setup and build choices than moment-to-moment buttons.

mechanics.core_loop: Generate Scrap through Scrap Shot, critical hits, and temporary engine effects; spend it through the active explosive and Mechsuit package; keep Scrapmaw and useful turrets contributing; and use Makeshift Dynamite to connect personal, suit, and pet damage.
mechanics.single_target: Scrapmaw, ranged criticals, Makeshift Dynamite, and Mechsuit abilities form the sustained engine, with Arclight Core and Overclocked Machine adding pet-triggered payoff.
mechanics.aoe: Sticky Bomb, dynamite, Mechsuit Combustion, upgraded turrets, and later Gear Grind provide overlapping pack tools.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Much of the gun and pet package works at range, but placed turrets and pet marks make rapid relocation or target turnover less efficient.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Mechsuit is both an offensive window and a durability tool; the Tinker class kit adds gadgets and control.
mechanics.group_utility: Turrets and gadgets broaden the effective bar beyond the damage priority, which current players describe as useful but crowded.

failure_modes.text: Spending Scrap without preserving the next Mechsuit, pet, or explosive payoff can leave the engine resource-starved.
Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: much of the gun and pet package works at range, but placed turrets and pet marks make rapid relocation or target turnover less efficient.
Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: mechsuit is both an offensive window and a durability tool; the tinker class kit adds gadgets and control.
